note: No A1 episode captured the asset in the 8,000-episode evaluation, so the success-oriented categories (normal success, evasive success, obstacle-heavy success, dense-clutter success) cannot be supplied. The list therefore inspects the failure behaviors that decided the verdict. All recordings use V2 semantics, map_local perception, deterministic inference.
